title: Drew Friedman
description: "Although I have not actually seen the STAR WARS movies, I do love them," admits the ever-offbeat Drew Friedman. "Illustrating 'The Emperor' is the high point of my career. Thank you all." Friedman has just celebrated his 60th year as an illustrator (according to Friedman), bringing so much joy and happiness to children and adults alike with his beloved renditions of clowns, rabbits, little girls and cigarette advertisements. In addition to books and various cable TV jobs, friedman lus worked on some choice assignments for Topps, the BARFO candy containers and TOXIC HIGH trading cards among them. It's no wonder that Drew holds the noteworthy distinction of being the favorite artist of radio personality Howard Stern. He is also a big fan of New York TV's Sandy Becker.
